messages.subject: For Stephen Schwarzman | Infrastructure, strategic partnerships and emerging-market stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Blackstone Press Office,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Stephen A. Schwarzman, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder.

Blackstone's scale across infrastructure and strategic sectors creates operating environments where government relationships, regulation and stakeholder confidence are central to long-term value creation. That intersection aligns closely with my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market operating experience might support Blackstone's portfolio priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Blackstone.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
